q: How do I list my property?
a: Login as a landlord, go to your dashboard, and fill out the listing form. Add photos, amenities, rent details, and you're good to go. Once submitted, your listing will be reviewed and published.

q: Can I edit or delete my listing?
a: Yes. Go to your 'My Listings' tab on your landlord dashboard. There you’ll see options to edit or delete each listing individually.

q: What does 'Your listing is about to expire!' or 'Your listing has expired.' mean?
a: Listings are active for a fixed duration (30 days by default). When your listing is near expiry or expired, you'll be notified. You can relist or extend it from your dashboard.

q: Why do I need to submit government verification? Is it even safe?
a: We require verification to ensure listings are legit and to protect student users. Your data is encrypted, never shared publicly, and only used for internal verification.

q: Can I put up multiple listings?
a: Yes, landlords can list multiple properties as long as they own or manage them. Each listing is reviewed individually.

q: Can I put up a listing for someone else?
a: We prefer if the listing is made by the property owner or an authorized representative. For special cases, contact us at contactus@cribconnect.

q: How do I know if my listing is visible to potential tenants?
a: Once your listing is approved, it becomes visible to all tenant users. You can preview it from your dashboard under 'My Listings'.

q: Why can I no longer access my account?
a: Your account may have been restricted due to multiple reports, policy violations, or verification issues. Contact support at contactus@cribconnect for details.

q: How to add photos and/or videos to my listing?
a: While creating or editing a listing, use the 'Add Media' section to upload photos and videos. Only supported file formats will be accepted.

q: Why can't I add videos to my listing?
a: Ensure your video file is under the size limit and in a supported format (MP4, MOV). Videos are optional but highly recommended for trust.

q: I am unable to post my listing.
a: Check that all required fields are filled and that you’ve uploaded the necessary documents. If the problem persists, contact support.

q: Why is the community inaccessible for me?
a: The community is designed for tenants to interact, share roommate requests, and post housing tips. Landlords do not have access to it.

q: How to find a PG or rental near me?
a: Login as a tenant, go to 'Browse Listings', and use filters like location, college, rent range, and preferences to find a suitable place.

q: How do I know if a listing or profile is credible and legit?
a: Verified listings have a 'Verified' tag. We also display user reviews and verification badges to help you make safe choices.

q: Can I filter search based on gender and food preferences?
a: Yes. Use the filter sidebar while browsing to select preferences like gender, veg/non-veg, smoking/drinking, and more.

q: Are there some hidden costs in the platform?
a: No hidden charges. Listing, searching, and communicating are completely free. Any fees are clearly displayed and optional.

q: Is there any deposit? Who sets it?
a: The landlord sets the deposit amount. You can view it in the listing details. CribConnect doesn't interfere with payment negotiations.

q: Can I contact the landlord directly?
a: Yes. You can contact landlords through the in-app messaging feature. Direct contact info is shared only after mutual consent.

q: How can I report a fraudulent profile or listing?
a: Every profile and listing has a 'Report' button. Tap it and choose the issue — our moderation team will review it within 5 business days.

q: I reported a profile, but they are still visible on the platform.
a: Our team manually investigates each report. If no violation is found, the profile remains. You’ll receive a notification once your report is reviewed.

q: What are the various tags and what do they mean?
a: Tags like 'Verified', 'Students Only', 'Female Preferred', etc., help you quickly assess listings based on your needs and safety filters.

q: How do I apply or show interest in a listing?
a: Use the 'I'm Interested' button on any listing. This sends a ping to the landlord, who can then initiate a chat or schedule a visit.

q: What are my communication mediums to contact a landlord?
a: You can use in-app chat or video call (optional if enabled by landlord). Phone numbers are only exchanged when both parties agree.

q: Can I bookmark or save a listing?
a: Yes. Click the heart icon on any listing to save it. Access all saved listings from your profile under the 'Saved' tab.

q: Where do I find the roommate request posts?
a: Go to the Community section. Filter by 'Roommate Requests'. You’ll see active posts sorted by location, college, and preferences.

q: What if there is no roommate request available at the moment?
a: You can post your own request in the community. Set preferences like gender, budget, location, and we’ll notify you if someone matches.

q: How do I contact or connect with a user?
a: Visit their profile and hit 'Request to Connect'. If accepted, you’ll be able to chat securely within the platform.

q: What if it's a landlord posing as and posting in the community?
a: We monitor this strictly. If you suspect someone is posing, report the profile or post. Verified tenant-only filters also reduce this risk.

q: I am unsure about giving out my personal details. Can I contact them without giving my details away?
a: Yes! Our encrypted chat ensures you stay anonymous unless you choose to reveal details. You can share info only after mutual approval.

q: Can I choose who I get matched with?
a: Yes. Our roommate matcher allows you to set preferences, and only people matching those preferences will be shown to you.

q: How to post on community?
a: Go to the Community tab and click 'Create Post'. You can post roommate requests, general advice, or questions. Posts are moderated.

q: How many days before action against a report?
a: Reports are manually reviewed within 5 business days. If the issue is urgent or repeated, action may be taken sooner.

q: Why can't I see some listings?
a: Listings may be filtered based on your preferences, college, or verification status. Try adjusting your filters or expanding your search radius.

q: Do you support paid partnerships with landlords or agents?
a: Currently, we do not support or promote paid promotions. All listings are displayed based on relevance and user filters only.

q: What if I want to deactivate or delete my account?
a: Go to your profile settings, scroll to 'Privacy & Security', and click on 'Delete Account'. This will permanently remove your data from our system.
